description: LR-FHSS capability exchange vectors (spec 02-physical-link.md §3.7). Gateway DIO LR_FHSS_SUPPORTED (reserved bit 7), node Announce LR_FHSS_CAPABLE (app_data bit 0). Negotiation per §3.7: SX1262 MAY use LR-FHSS if gateway supports and node prefers; gateway MUST dual-mode RX; downlink matches uplink; peer-to-peer defaults to LORA.

vectors.name: gateway_advertises_supported
vectors.description: Gateway sets LR_FHSS_SUPPORTED bit 7 in DIO

vectors.name: node_capable_announce
vectors.description: SX1262 node sets LR_FHSS_CAPABLE bit 0 in Announce app_data

vectors.name: node_not_capable
vectors.description: SX127x node ignores flags, not capable

vectors.name: negotiate_uplink_lr_fhss_success
vectors.description: Both capable and node prefers -> LR-FHSS uplink

vectors.name: negotiate_uplink_fallback_gateway_no_support
vectors.description: Gateway does not support -> fallback to LORA

vectors.name: negotiate_uplink_fallback_node_not_capable
vectors.description: SX127x node -> LORA even if gateway supports

vectors.name: downlink_matches_uplink_lr_fhss
vectors.description: Downlink always matches mode of node's most recent uplink

vectors.name: peer_to_peer_negotiated_both_capable
